_comment: Per-tool schema for the command taxonomy (docs/command_taxonomy.md §5). The first entry is the empty template; the rest are worked examples for existing tools on main db8d39e3.

arguments.role: Agent | Theme | Source | Goal | Path | Instrument | Manner | Recipient | Extent | Time

examples.name: approach_object

aspect.goal_predicate: robot in front of the object at its stand-off, facing it (the object's own approach affordance holds)
aspect.progress_signal: controller intention_state lines (orienting, driving to the standpoint, goal holds)
aspect.interrupt: stop / para fast path; a new command supersedes it

arguments.notes: a name (chair_1), a class (nearest), or 'my chair' (resolved through the person's owns edges)
the person's words ('from behind', 'por la izquierda'); a side the object does not list is refused

examples.mood_handling: imperative and indirect ('could you go to the chair', 'quiero que vayas a mi silla') read by the chat model; a remembered-only object goes through the code-built fast path (turn, wait, approach on_fail=skip, report)
examples.clarification_policy: missing object: ask which one; a class with several instances: the nearest, said in the reply; object not in the current room: plan_mission (cross legs first)
examples.execution_contract: claims the base; sends the controller an approach intention aimed at the object's aff_<name>_approach node; completion/failure arrive as intention_state lines and are said by the chat

examples.name: explore
examples.process_type: material (with perceptual side effect: the map and objects grow)

aspect.goal_predicate: none intrinsic; optional until=explored(room) >= p turns it telic
aspect.interrupt: stop, pause, continue, cancel mission; budget_s ends it

arguments.notes: a room node, or a $var bound by an earlier cross
the validator REQUIRES the bound: an atelic step must end

examples.mood_handling: via plan_mission; 'look around', 'explora la habitación', 'mira a ver qué hay'
examples.clarification_policy: no bound given: the planner picks the skill's default budget and the card shows it, so the person can change it before yes
examples.execution_contract: claims the base; the controller's exploration drive runs in the room until budget or predicate; result folded into the mission's wake summary

examples.name: where_is

arguments.notes: an object name, a class, a colour + class, or 'my chair'

temporal: past (LTOM: last seen in room_N, X ago)
examples.mood_handling: interrogative; 'do you know where…', '¿sabes dónde está…?' are the same question
examples.clarification_policy: several matches: all are listed; nothing known: says it has not been perceived (never guesses)
examples.execution_contract: reads the live graph and the LTOM graph (domain 5); the answer is said verbatim when it comes from memory

examples.name: wait (at=)
examples.speech_act: directive (temporal precondition of the rest of the mission)

aspect.goal_predicate: wall clock >= at, or until=pred holds
aspect.interrupt: stop, cancel mission; a new mission supersedes it

arguments.notes: absolute ISO local time with offset; the planner writes HH:MM and language_agent grounds it to the next occurrence

examples.mood_handling: 'a las 6 ve a la cocina', 'at 6 go to the kitchen', 'dentro de diez minutos…'
examples.clarification_policy: one of at / s / until is required; a time already past ends the wait at once (said on the card as the grounded date)
examples.execution_contract: claims the base (the robot holds still while waiting: the reason a reminder needs a non-claiming scheduler, proposal P3); not persisted across a controller restart
